This berry is found chiefly in arid climates, especially in volcanic terrain, and is best known in western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is prepared as a paste.

This berry from Mordor, prepared as a paste, restores 20 concussion hits and doubles the healing rate. It burns the skin, causes 1–10 rounds of stun, and almost always leaves a scar.
